stories.title: NFL training camp updates: Camp standouts and key questions for all 32 teams
stories.summary: Get all the latest news, intel and insights on NFL training camps from our team of reporters in the field.

stories.title: Brewers tie largest shutout with 22-0 rout of M's
stories.summary: The Brewers matched baseball's modern-era record for the largest shutout in MLB history, beating the Mariners 22-0 on Tuesday night.

stories.title: Five Buss siblings 'united' in selling Lakers shares
stories.summary: Five of the six members of the Buss trust say they are "united" in their intention to sell their remaining shares in the Lakers, despite pushback from Jeanie Buss.

stories.title: Clark, Mitchell set mark for WNBA duo in Fever win
stories.summary: Kelsey Mitchell scored 16 points in the first quarter and finished with 29 before sitting out the fourth, Caitlin Clark added 24 points and the Fever beat the Tempo 101-95 on Tuesday for their fifth straight victory.

stories.title: Tatis robs Lindor of slam, hits 2 HRs in Padres' win
stories.summary: Fernando Tatis Jr. reached over the right-field wall to rob the Mets' Francisco Lindor of a grand slam and also hit two home runs on Tuesday night to lead the Padres to a 5-2 win.
